verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm Galileo serves a live llms.txt at docs.galileo.ai that indexes a 198-page documentation bundle. They also confirm markdown versions of docs pages, which point agents back to that llms.txt index, so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs directly. Many cited doc URLs use the .md form, which corroborates the machine-readable format. Missing for 10: first-party documentation explaining how to use llms.txt or the markdown docs with agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.galileo.ai/llms.txt # Galileo
